children: JGBs edge higher in price terms in Tokyo's morning session amid mixed developments. On the one hand, JGBs are likely to be underpinned by the Bank of Japan's planned outright purchases today of three sectors of Japan's government bond market such as sovereign securities with tenors of more than five years and up to 10 years. Another market-supportive factor is lower oil prices that tend to ease inflationary pressure in Japan. On the other hand, however, investors might adopt a cautious stance amid substantial volatility in yields, market observers say. The 10-year JGB yield is down 1 bp at 2.860%. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
